implemented_contract: Only compared substantive same-authority source versions can become a current publisher-revision comparison; original published_at stays unchanged.
Publisher updated_at must strictly advance from the previous version, lie in the current window and be locally known by as_of. First_seen never becomes a publication/revision time.
Before/after source fields reconstruct full previous source_body and immutable prior paragraph evidence with full hashes/identity/version.
Only an eligible source request adds novelty=unchanged/added/revised and prior_evidence_ids. Ordinary fresh/noneligible source request/schema is unchanged.

Each fact selects current evidence and per-claim novelty; two facts in one changed paragraph can have different timing. Exact unchanged paragraphs cannot be labeled new; revised claims require prior evidence from this source.

Unchanged claims and explicit historical_as_reported remain background. Added/revised claims from a verified current revision can use existing typed economic mechanisms/scopes; no sign/weight is repaired.
Details retain original publication, publisher revision, local knowledge time and full selected prior quote; old nonrevision renders are byte-identical.
test_evidence_boundary: CPU fixtures use exact stored Cheniere paragraph content combined into explicitly constructed before/after versions and diagnostic clocks. They are not observed publisher revision pairs or model novelty accuracy results.
Metadata-only, same/missing publisher clock, unknown-future local version, authority migration and first-seen-only changes cannot become new source publication.
The already-saved real2.4.5 mixed classes, weights, closing plan and four renders were replayed with zero model calls. Their classification, weight and closing request tuples are exactly unchanged.

A genuine ordinary old-article authoritative before/after revision pair has not yet been run through20b. It requires final frozen-source real testing before claiming full revision semantic acceptance.
limitations: Semantic novelty inside changed paragraphs is a model judgement over both immutable versions, not programmatically verified entailment.

A completely removed claim with no new current evidence paragraph is not directly normalized as a standalone retraction in this minimal proposal. A source-provided current correction/reversal paragraph can be compared; deletion-only semantic retraction remains a limitation.
No legacy data, old formal predictions, analysis reviews or frozen validation baseline changed.
